::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 9th [?1854]  
**From:** Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection,  C0171: Box 29
:::

My dear [Miss Millington](people/person_1000.qmd)
This is a very amusing chapter, and I am glad to hear that [Blue Mantle](people/person_836.qmd)[^1] directed you to the right quarter for the next subject to be entered into heraldry.[^2]  It seems to be an inexhaustible fund of curious information. I am overhurried today so pray excuse my blundering

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Henry Murray Lane (1833-1913), Bluemantle Pursuivant at the College of Arms (1849-1864).
[^2]: Her heraldry articles ran in [MP](organizations/other_52.qmd) from 1853-1857.
